question: What is the percentage of the customers who used EUR in 2012/8/25?
clarification: Count each distinct CustomerID only once.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CustomerID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25'
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25'

b.request: Among distinct customers who made a transaction on 2012-08-25, what percentage have Currency = 'EUR', counting each CustomerID once?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID), 0) AS percentage_eur FROM transactions_1k AS t JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';

d.request: What percentage of customers used EUR on 2012-08-25, counting each distinct CustomerID only once?
d.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID), 0) AS percentage FROM transactions_1k AS t JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';
